## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [白法祖](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%99%BD%E6%B3%95%E7%A5%96) Bái Fǎzǔ is a Mahāyāna sūtra on the bodhisattva's cultivation (*xiū xíng* 修行) — i.e. the practical implementation of the bodhisattva path. The work was incorporated into the *[Mahā-ratnakūṭa](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0001)* tradition.

**Abstract**

[白法祖](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%99%BD%E6%B3%95%E7%A5%96) Bái Fǎzǔ (active late 3rd / early 4th c.) was a Western-Jìn-period Buddhist translator working in the period 290 – 306 CE per the *Chū sānzàng jì jí* (T2145). The bracket adopted here reflects this window. He is also credited with the *Wǔ kǔ zhāng jù jīng* 五苦章句經 and other shorter Buddhist translations; his translations were largely produced at the Western-Jìn capital Luòyáng.

The Taishō text (T0330) is established on the standard apparatus.
